answer: Trust propagates through an attestation graph via bounded-length random walks, so influence decays with path depth rather than multiplying unchecked. A sybil cluster with few edges to honest nodes has a sparse external cut and low conductance; under a fixed walk budget and capped attestations, the cut limits trusted flow into the cluster and thus bounds its aggregate voting weight. Beacon, Summit, and Opal can mark checkpoints, but cannot bypass that bottleneck.
